title: Tiny, cute violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="46" y="12" width="8" height="30" rx="3" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="47" y="12" width="2" height="30" rx="1" fill="#C4945A"/>
  <!-- Pegbox -->
  <rect x="45" y="8" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#6B3A1F"/>
  <!-- Pegs -->
  <rect x="41" y="11" width="5" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#D4A060"/>
  <rect x="54" y="11" width="5" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#D4A060"/>
  <rect x="41" y="15" width="5" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#D4A060"/>
  <rect x="54" y="15" width="5" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#D4A060"/>
  <!-- Upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#C4701E"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="12" ry="9.5" fill="#E09040"/>
  <!-- Waist / waist curves -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="9" ry="8" fill="#C4701E"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="7.5" ry="6.5" fill="#E09040"/>
  <!-- Lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#C4701E"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#E09040"/>
  <!-- F-holes -->
  <path d="M42 50 Q44 54 43 58" stroke="#7A3D10" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="49" r="1" fill="#7A3D10"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="58.5" r="1" fill="#7A3D10"/>
  <path d="M58 50 Q56 54 57 58" stroke="#7A3D10" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="57.5" cy="49" r="1" fill="#7A3D10"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="58.5" r="1" fill="#7A3D10"/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x="44" y="56" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#A0581C"/>
  <!-- Tailpiece -->
  <path d="M46 62 L50 74 L54 62 Z" fill="#7A3D10"/>
  <!-- Tailpiece fine tuner -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="75" r="1.5" fill="#D4A060"/>
  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1="48" y1="20" x2="48" y2="74" stroke="#F0D890" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="74" stroke="#F0D890" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="52" y1="20" x2="52" y2="74" stroke="#F0D890" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="49" y1="20" x2="49" y2="74" stroke="#F0D890" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="51" y1="20" x2="51" y2="74" stroke="#F0D890" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <!-- Chin rest -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="68" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#3A2010"/>
  <!-- Fingerboard highlight -->
  <rect x="47" y="22" width="2" height="28" rx="1" fill="#A06030" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Scroll curl -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="9" r="3.5" fill="#6B3A1F"/>
  <path d="M50 6 Q53 9 50 12" stroke="#D4A060" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Cute face on body! -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="60" r="1.2" fill="#5A2A08"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="60" r="1.2" fill="#5A2A08"/>
  <path d="M47.5 62.5 Q50 64.5 52.5 62.5" stroke="#5A2A08" stroke-width="0.9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#E07050" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#E07050" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Bow -->
  <line x1="12" y1="86" x2="42" y2="46" stroke="#C4945A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="14" y1="84" x2="44" y2="44" stroke="#E8D8B0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="87" r="2.5" fill="#3A2010"/>
  <!-- Bow tip -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="45" r="1.5" fill="#3A2010"/>
  <!-- Bow hair shimmer -->
  <line x1="16" y1="82" x2="40" y2="48" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
